arguments.name: URL or input file
arguments.description: URL or file path to OpenAPI Specification file

options.name: --additional-namespace
options.description: Add additional namespace to generated types

options.name: --cancellation-tokens
options.description: Use cancellation tokens

options.name: --collection-format
options.description:
The collection format to use for query parameters. Default is Multi.
May be one of:
- Multi: Multiple parameter instances rather than  multiple values. Only supported for the in: query and in: formData parameters.  (?param=value1&param=value2)
- Csv: Comma-separated values.  (?param=value1,value2)
- Ssv: Space-separated values. (?param=value1 value2)
- Tsv: Tab-separated values. (?param=value1\tvalue2)
- Pipes: Pipe-separated  values. (?param=value1|value2)
See  https://swagger.io/docs/specification/v2_0/describing-parameters/#array-and-mult i-value-parameters for more information.

options.name: --contract-only
options.description: Don't generate clients

options.name: --contracts-namespace
options.description: Default namespace to use for generated contracts

options.name: --contracts-output
options.description: Output path for generated contracts. Enabling this  automatically enables generating multiple files

options.name: --custom-template-directory
options.description: Custom directory with NSwag fluid templates for code  generation. Default is null which uses the default NSwag templates. See  https://github.com/RicoSuter/NSwag/wiki/Templates

options.name: --disposable
options.description: Generate refit clients that implement IDisposable

options.name: --exclude-namespace
options.description: Exclude namespace on generated types

options.name: --generate-authentication-header
options.description: Controls generation of Authorization header support.  Options: None (no authentication code is generated), Parameter (adds method  parameters for authentication), Method (generates a Refit [[Headers]] attribute  for bearer token authentication). For backward compatibility, the legacy boolean forms 'true', 'false', or omitting the value are also  accepted. Also see 'security-scheme' option

options.name: --ignored-operation-headers
options.description: A collection of headers to omit from operation  signatures.

options.name: --immutable-records
options.description: Generate contracts as immutable records instead of  classes

options.name: --include-inheritance-hierarchy
options.description: Keep all possible inherited types/union types even if they are not directly used.

options.name: --integer-type
options.description: The .NET type to use for OpenAPI integers without a format specifier. May be one of: Int32, Int64

options.name: --interface-only
options.description: Don't generate contract types

options.name: --internal
options.description: Set the accessibility of the generated types to  'internal'

options.name: --json-serializer-context
options.description: Generate JsonSerializerContext for AOT compilation  support

options.name: --keep-schema
options.description: Force to keep matching schema, uses regular expressions.  Use together with "--trim-unused-schema". Can be set multiple times.

options.name: --match-path
options.description: Only include Paths that match the provided regular  expression. May be set multiple times.

options.name: --multiple-files
options.description:
Generate multiple files instead of a single large  file.
The output files can be the following:
- RefitInterfaces.cs
-  DependencyInjection.cs
- Contracts.cs

options.name: --multiple-interfaces
options.description: Generate a Refit interface for each endpoint. May be one  of ByEndpoint, ByTag

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Default namespace to use for generated types

options.name: --no-accept-headers
options.description: Don't add <Accept> header to output file

options.name: --no-auto-generated-header
options.description: Don't add <auto-generated> header to output file

options.name: --no-banner
options.description: Don't show donation banner

options.name: --no-deprecated-operations
options.description: Don't generate deprecated operations

options.name: --no-inline-json-converters
options.description: Don't inline JsonConverter attributes for enum  properties. When disabled, enum properties will not have  [[JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]] attributes

options.name: --no-logging
options.description: Don't log errors or collect telemetry

options.name: --no-operation-headers
options.description: Don't generate operation headers

options.name: --no-xml-doc-comments
options.description: Don't generate XML doc comments for interfaces and  operations

options.name: --operation-name-generator
options.description:
The NSwag IOperationNameGenerator implementation to  use.
May be one of:
- Default
- MultipleClientsFromOperationId
-  MultipleClientsFromPathSegments
- MultipleClientsFromFirstTagAndOperationId
-  MultipleClientsFromFirstTagAndOperationName
-  MultipleClientsFromFirstTagAndPathSegments
- SingleClientFromOperationId
-  SingleClientFromPathSegments
See  https://refitter.github.io/api/Refitter.Core.OperationNameGeneratorTypes.html  for more information.

options.name: --operation-name-template
options.description: Generate operation names using pattern. When using  --multiple-interfaces ByEndpoint, this is name of the Execute() method in the  interface where all instances of the string '{operationName}' is  replaced with 'Execute'.

options.name: --optional-nullable-parameters
options.description: Generate nullable parameters as optional parameters

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to Output file or folder (if multiple files are  generated)

options.name: --property-naming-policy
options.description: Controls how generated contract properties are named. May  be one of PascalCase, PreserveOriginal

options.name: --security-scheme
options.description: Generate Authorization header for the given security  scheme. When omitted, authentication headers will be generated for all security  schemes.

options.name: --settings-file
options.description: Path to .refitter settings file. Specifying this will  ignore all other settings (except for --output)

options.name: --simple-output
options.description: Generate simple, plain-text console output without ASCII  art, tables, emojis, or color formatting (suitable for IDE output windows)

options.name: --skip-default-additional-properties
options.description: Set to true to skip default additional properties

options.name: --skip-validation
options.description: Skip validation of the OpenAPI specification

options.name: --tag
options.description: Only include Endpoints that contain this tag. May be set  multiple times and result in OR'ed evaluation.

options.name: --trim-unused-schema
options.description: Removes unreferenced components schema to keep the  generated output to a minimum

options.name: --use-api-response
options.description: Return Task<IApiResponse<T>> instead  of Task<T>

options.name: --use-apizr
options.description:
Use Apizr by:
- Adding a final IApizrRequestOptions  options parameter to all generated methods
- Providing cancellation tokens by  Apizr request options instead of a dedicated parameter
- Using method overloads instead of optional parameters
See https://refitter.github.io for more  information and https://www.apizr.net to get started with Apizr.

options.name: --use-dynamic-querystring-parameters
options.description:
Enable wrapping multiple query parameters into a single  complex one. Default is no wrapping.
See  https://github.com/reactiveui/refit?tab=readme-ov-file#dynamic-querystring-param eters for more information.

options.name: --use-iso-date-format
options.description: Explicitly format date query string parameters in ISO 8601 standard date format using delimiters (2023-06-15)

options.name: --use-observable-response
options.description: Return IObservable instead of Task

options.name: --use-polymorphic-serialization
options.description:
Use System.Text.Json polymorphic serialization.
Replaces  NSwag JsonInheritanceConverter attributes with System.Text.Json  JsonPolymorphicAttributes.
To have the native support of inheritance  (de)serialization and fallback to base types when
payloads with (yet) unknown  types are offered by newer versions of an API
See  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/serialization/system-text-json /polymorphism for more information
